title: A seed starts growing
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: With suitable conditions, a viable seed can germinate and the embryo resumes growth into a seedling. Requirements vary across species, so water, oxygen and temperature are not a complete rule for every seed.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain germination from seed to seedling in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A viable seed has water, oxygen and a suitable temperature. When germination succeeds, what begins to emerge and grow? With suitable conditions, a viable seed can germinate and the embryo resumes growth into a seedling. Requirements vary across species, so water, oxygen and temperature are not a complete rule for every seed.
